name: Manors Golf
why_quiet: Borderline fit: Manors is streetwear-adjacent and runs logo tees, prints and collabs, so the picks are limited to its quiet core: 100% merino Tech knits (crew, vest, quarter-zip windbreaker) in Dune/Hickory/Midnight, a Primaloft cardigan, and pleated / wide-cut trousers in earthy neutrals. Note the merino knits carry a small chest emblem patch. Design focus is cut and silhouette drawn from golf's golden era.

quote.text: Some of the designs might seem quite basic, but the cut and silhouette is something we really wanted to emphasize.

facts.fact: London-based; set up in 2019 by school friends Jojo Regan and Luke Davies, joined by Nick Watts as Fashion Director.
Cites Arnold Palmer, Gary Player and Jack Nicklaus as influences; mantra 'personality before performance' (2021).
Classic Collection (2021) built on argyle cardigans, wide-legged trousers and polos with a 1950s Ivy feel.
Harrods lists the brand as co-founded and owned by Jojo Regan, Luke Davies and Nick Watts.
Merino Tech pieces are 100% natural merino wool, treated to be machine-washable (per product copy).
Ships to the US with USD pricing (US market active; prices read from product-page structured data).

life.desc: 3200x1800 (source 6606x3715). Lone golfer mid-swing in dune grass on a seaside links at dusk, pink sky, moon overhead.
2000x2999. Golfer in grey knit crewneck and cap on a fairway, trees behind; calm, tonal.
2000x2999. Golfer in oatmeal knit sweater and cream trousers with a leather carry bag on a parkland course.

hero_candidate.desc: Landscape, small golfer swinging in links dune grass at dusk, sea horizon and moon; very calm and atmospheric. Golfer wears a cap with small logo, otherwise quiet.

notes: Store base currency GBP (myshopify products.json); 'price' is GBP, 'usd' is what a US shopper is charged per manorsgolf.com product-page JSON-LD (priceCurrency USD). manorsgolf.com is a Hydrogen storefront, so /products.json 404s there; catalogue read from manorsgolf.myshopify.com/products.json.
